admission.justification: Enforced by the pointer-uniqueness detector and the action derivation in test support, run by a test over every native first message; two pointers for one action make an agent read twice or choose.

applicability: Detail pointers in the l-01 role, operation and every-role texts that native roles receive in their first message.
conditions: A pointer's action is read from its Before, When or For clause.
exclusions: Duplicate shapes the detector does not parse: extra links inside a listed multi-link sentence, one action under two listed wordings, reference-style links, autolinks and skill:// paths with ./ segments.
Content that a whole-file handover pointer and a section pointer both reach.
